items.title: File Cleveland County business personal property return
items.description: Oklahoma businesses file a Business Personal Property Rendition (OTC Form 901) with the county assessor between January 1 and March 15 (68 O.S. 2836); after March 15 a mandatory 10% penalty applies, and 20% after April 15. Mailed renditions must be postmarked by March 15. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state rule applies. The link is the state statute.

items.title: File Oklahoma County business personal property return
items.description: Oklahoma business personal property statements (Form 901) are due to the county assessor by March 15; a 10% penalty applies after.
